metadata.title: A machine‐learning model of academic resilience in the times of the COVID‐19 pandemic: Evidence drawn from 79 countries/economies in the PISA 2022 mathematics study

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study used a single plausible value for mathematics literacy instead of multiple plausible values.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study explicitly states that it did not apply sampling weights in the analysis.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study does not mention using multilevel modeling or any method that accounts for school clustering in the analysis.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study performed only internal validation using 10-fold cross-validation, which does not qualify as validation beyond the estimation sample.
